description: Empty permission set. The frontend imports `invoke` from @tauri-apps/api/core but uses ZERO Tauri core APIs (no window, event, path, app, image, menu, tray, webview, resources). The only IPC surface is custom commands (`copy_xml_to_clipboard` and `show_main_window`) registered via the `invoke_handler!` macro in src/lib.rs. Granting `core:default` would expose 9 plugin permission sets the app never touches.
